name: Spartan Hatchet V
source:
You play as a spartan to the most powerful lineage blessed by [url=https://vndb.org/c168472]Cyba the Elf Goddess[/url]. You bear unmatched strength, unbreakable will, and a destiny written in divine fire. Your family has been blessed for thousands of years to serve the goddess. With a mere clap of your hands, you double your existence--creating a clone army at your disposal. Your sacred mission: hunt down the final pieces of the Scattered Divine.

[From [URL=https://www.patreon.com/posts/official-for-148958937]Patreon[/URL]]
